summary_en: Takara Standard acquired 142,000 shares (0.2% of outstanding shares) on September 14, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading at the closing price of 3,065 yen. This block purchase is part of a broader buyback program approved by the board on April 30, 2026, with a total acquisition cap of 4.6 million shares (7.27% of outstanding shares) and 12 billion yen through May 2027.
title_en: Notice of Self-Share Acquisition via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 14, 2026, Takara Standard executed a block purchase of 142,000 ordinary shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading at 3,065 yen per share, representing 0.2% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The transaction was settled at the Tokyo Stock Exchange opening on that date, with execution contingent on matching sell orders in the same time window.

This block purchase forms part of a broader treasury stock acquisition program authorized by the board of directors on April 30, 2026. The full program permits acquisition of up to 4.6 million shares (7.27% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 12 billion yen through February 19, 2027, using ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases. Completion of this individual block transaction was announced immediately after settlement.
